candidates.description: This feature represents uppercase and lowercase consonant tokens commonly used in text data.
This vector represents numerical values, specifically integer quantities often used in measurements, counts, or data points.
This vector is related to the German suffix "-ahr-" and its morphological variations found within common words and roots.
This vector represents numerical values within a specific height range in centimeters.
This feature vector activates strongly on French words and tokens containing acute, grave, or circumflex accented characters.
This feature vector represents proper nouns, specifically historical, mythological, and contemporary personal or geographic names starting with capital letters.
This vector represents proper nouns, names, and name-like lexical roots beginning with capitalized consonant-vowel combinations, particularly involving the letters 'ou'.
This feature vector activates on tokens representing arbitrary multi-digit numbers.
This vector represents traditional European masculine given names.
This vector is activated by tokens containing the root sequence "us" or "use", particularly within proper nouns and common English words.
